page_title: BAR 1-0 RAY | Barcelona v Rayo Vallecano 17/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: de Tomas R. Lacking Match Fitness

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' Mario Melero shows a yellow card to Ferran Torres (Barcelona) for his blatant foul.
90+5' Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

90+5' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) latches on to a brilliant through ball in a promising position, but one of the defenders is alert to the danger and dispossess him. Rayo Vallecano force a corner. They send men into the box.
90+2' PENALTY APPEAL after Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.

90+1' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) has a big opportunity to score! He climbs highest deep inside the penalty box and strikes a powerful header towards the goal. Next time he should aim better as his effort flies narrowly over the bar.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
88' Marc Casado (Barcelona) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Frenkie de Jong.
87' Inigo Perez decides to make a substitution. Alvaro Garcia will be replaced by Sergio Guardiola (Rayo Vallecano).
87' Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Mario Melero had an easy-decision to make.
86' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.

85' Andrei Ratiu almost found himself in a promising position after Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) tried to send a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defenders reacts well and makes a timely interception.

82' Raphinha (Barcelona) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the left side of the goal. Augusto Batalla displays brilliant reflexes and pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
81' Hansi Flick has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Eric Garcia (Barcelona) replacing Pau Cubarsi.
81' Here's the change. Robert Lewandowski leaves the pitch and Ferran Torres (Barcelona) comes on as a substitute.
80' Dani Olmo almost gets into in a promising position, but the through ball by Jules Kounde (Barcelona) from just inside the box is intercepted by one of the defending players.
78' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.

77' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Wojciech Szczesny makes a decent save to deny his effort directed low to the middle of the target.
75' Abdul Mumin (Rayo Vallecano) commits a rough challenge and Mario Melero blows his whistle for an infringement.
74' Inigo Perez has decided to substitute Pathe Ciss and he is replaced by Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano).
74' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) comes onto the pitch so that Isi Palazon can be given a rest.
72' Raphinha (Barcelona) is afforded space inside the box after collecting a pass, but the chance is wasted as his shot goes harmlessly over the crossbar.
72' Barcelona quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

71' Raphinha (Barcelona) gets to the rebound inside the box and shoots towards the left post, but his sidefooter is blocked by an alert Augusto Batalla. What a save! Barcelona have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
70' 3:4 – the corner kicks stats.
70' Great teamplay by Barcelona as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

67' Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) receives a short pass inside a congested penalty area and takes a first-time shot. The effort heads towards the middle of the goal but Wojciech Szczesny blocks the shot with his legs.
66' It's time for a substitution. Jules Kounde (Barcelona) comes on in place of Hector Fort.
66' Hansi Flick prepares a substitution. Gavi is replaced by Dani Olmo (Barcelona).
64' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

63' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Raphinha (Barcelona) inside the box. He lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but Augusto Batalla was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
61' Here is a change. Pedro Diaz is going off and Inigo Perez gives the last tactical orders to Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano).
61' Substitution. Randy Nteka leaves the pitch and is replaced by Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano).
61' Mario Melero blows his whistle and it's Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
60' Raphinha (Barcelona) steps up to send the ball in.

60' A pass lands at the feet of Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender. The ball goes out for a corner. Barcelona can continue in their attacking effort.
57' Raphinha (Barcelona) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
57' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Augusto Batalla is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
55' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
54' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) is asking for medical treatment, but he will have to leave the pitch in order to receive help from the physio.
53' Pedri plays a lovely pass into Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona), but he can't find the target. His strike from inside the box goes narrowly wide of the right post.
53' Pedri (Barcelona) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

52' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) finds himself in a promising position after receiving an excellent pass into the box, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention to avert the threat. The ball goes out of play. Barcelona are awarded a corner kick.
52' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Robert Lewandowski, but he can't get on the end of the pass.

51' Raphinha (Barcelona) plays an extraordinary diagonal pass and Lamine Yamal darts into free space to control the ball. The ball is cleared after Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
50' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) tries to play a through ball from just inside the box to Robert Lewandowski, but one of the defending players is alert to the danger and makes a timely interception.
49' Raphinha (Barcelona) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
47' An attempted cross from Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) is cleared.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+3' Abdul Mumin (Rayo Vallecano) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Wojciech Szczesny has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
45+3' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
45+3' Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. The ball is out of play and Rayo Vallecano manage to earn a corner.
45+2' Gavi (Barcelona) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.

45' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) latches on to the corner kick and releases a quick strike from the edge of the box. The result differs significantly from his intention as the ball flies way over the crossbar.
45' Rayo Vallecano work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
44' Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Rayo Vallecano will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
44' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
43' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
41' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
40' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.

37' Wojciech Szczesny pulls off a great save to deny Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom right corner. Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) picks up the rebound after chaos in the box and directs a sweet strike towards the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper, however, denies him with a stunning save.
34' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.

31' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) blows a clear opportunity to score a goal. He was one-on-one with Augusto Batalla inside the six-yard box and attempted to put the ball into the bottom right corner, but was denied by a great save.
28' 1 - 0 Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) easily converts the penalty kick as he sends the ball straight into the bottom left corner, ricocheting in off the post. Augusto Batalla was helpless.
28' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
27' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
27' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Barcelona!
26' Referee Mario Melero makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
25' Good clearance! Gavi (Barcelona) receives a brilliant short pass and finds himself in a good position inside the box, but he's robbed of the ball by one of the defending players.
25' Inigo Martinez (Barcelona) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
25' Barcelona have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

24' Raphinha (Barcelona) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Barcelona.

23' Raphinha (Barcelona) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom right corner. Augusto Batalla guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.

22' Gavi makes a nice run and receives a pin-point long through ball from Pau Cubarsi (Barcelona). It would probably have put him one-on-one with the keeper, but one of the defenders makes a great block.
20' Good chance! Raphinha (Barcelona) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored!
19' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
17' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) plays a terrific long ball forward to Raphinha, but he can't beat his man and the move breaks down.
16' A lofted cross from Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
14' Abdul Mumin (Rayo Vallecano) climbs high to connect with a perfect cross and produces a header that goes not far wide of the left post.
14' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

13' Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano have been awarded a corner kick.
10' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) heads on.

9' Raphinha (Barcelona) gets to a rebound and attempts to score with a header. Augusto Batalla is in the right place at the right time and keeps out the effort which was heading into the bottom left corner.
6' Barcelona hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
4' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) meets a brilliant cross and steers a fine header goalwards, but it flies just wide of the right post.
3' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Rayo Vallecano will kick the game off.
Mario Melero will officiate today.
